title: Simulating Holographic Conformal Field Theories on Hyperbolic Lattices
abstract: Demonstrates that hyperbolic lattice settings combining nonlinear dynamics universally encode aspects of AdS/CFT bulk-boundary correspondence. Features emergent CFTs with nontrivial correlations on the boundary. Rydberg arrays are a proposed experimental realization. Published Phys. Rev. Lett. 2024.
key_claims: Hyperbolic lattice + nonlinear dynamics encodes AdS/CFT
Boundary CFT emerges with correct nontrivial correlations
Rydberg arrays are natural experimental platform for hyperbolic holographic models
Gravitational self-interactions in bulk simulated via nonlinear dynamics
